text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the first day of summer
camp! With
the sun beating down on us,
I'm ready to put Ines
Fujin through some
special training!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Ryan. I'm looking forward to
your
guidance during our afternoon
training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Right! Let's put in some good work and
get you
prepped for the autumn Tenno
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Since I won't be able to enter, I'll be
counting on
you to uphold the Mejiro
name.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Erm, I was just thinking that if I
want to be
like Ryan, I'll need to build
some more muscle
first.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Why were you watching me,
anyway?! Hurry
up and take the luggage
to our rooms!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
This summer camp will be over before
you know
it, and I don't want to waste a
single moment!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, our summer camp begins.
